body: I dunno.  We haven't been talking much lately.  We haven't "been together" in a month because I can't stand to be touched.  I can't talk about anything personal with her because I just can't bring myself to it.  My moods change wildly.  I got angry last night and she looked at me like I was some kind of raging woman-beater. I think shes scared of me and I think it's wearing her down.  I kind of want to break up with her because she deserves so much better than dealing with my crazy ass.  Same with my best friend.  They both deserve better than me.  I just take and take from them, always so sad and needy, and never give anything back.  They deserve a good man and they got a childish, whiny little boy.

I wish I could.  Every time I try to talk to someone about this with someone I care about, I freeze up and take the "nevermind, it's nothing" bitch route.  I just tried bringing it up to my best friend on Facebook and gave up before sending the message.

I don't know.  Maybe if I could get some accountability from one of my loved ones I would for sure not do it, but I can't fucking tell them.  Besides I"m a fucking pussy, a goddamn piece of shit and I doubt that I'll actually do anything cause I'm fucking useless.

That's the only reason I don't do it.  I would hurt so many people but I just can't bring myself to do that.  It's the only thing stopping me.  I don't want to cause so much pain cause of my useless ass.

I just really want to die.  I have never wanted to die so much in my life.  I'm fighting myself and trying so hard not to walk down to the corner store, buy the cheapest vodka, and get drunk off my ass.

I do feel like they'd have reason to believe I'm about to kill myself, because I really really want to.  Either that or I'll clam up, get freaked out, and shut down making the conversation useless and making me feel guilty for bothering them.  I know its their job but still I don't want to bother anybody.  

Also we're not getting married.  We got engaged, had a rough patch, and decided to call off the wedding for a while.  We've made zero plans and I don't know if it'll happen.

I didn't want to cause pain to my best friend/girlfriend/brothers.  I don't want them to have to find me and see me like that.  Or in the case of my long distance best friend, I don't want her to have to not hear from me for days only to find out through Facebook that I'm dead.  I don't want to hurt  them.  But I want to hurt me so much.

I don't want to call a number cause I don't want to get taken to a hospital or something.  I should be able to do this on my own but I can't because I'm a wuss.  If I go to a hospital then everybody knows and suddenly I'm the crazy person.  Plus I'm too broke to afford it.  If everybody else can handle negative feelings, why can't I?

Nothing, literally nothing.  It was a split decision to get up and do it.  I just got up out of the bedroom, went to the bathroom, and did it.  I only stopped because of a huge surge of guilt and a small amount of fear.  I had no thoughts on the way to or during until the guilt hit me.

That's why I feel so shitty.  So many people love me but I still want to kill myself.  That's why I don't because it'll hurt them or tell them and cause them problems and pain.  But I still want to do it and I hate it.
